pcb_source.reason: Do not manufacture a guessed J12/J15 or mounting-hole geometry.

carrier_mechanical_reference.resolution_policy: Use manufacturer CAD/drawing or direct caliper/CMM measurement of the actual AXU2CGB. Product photographs are review aids only and must not be converted into manufacturing coordinates.
carrier_mechanical_reference.schematic_boundary_note: J12/J15 are intentionally modelled as purchased-host logical boundaries with on_board=no. If direct mezzanine mating is selected, add only the minimum reviewed expansion-board mating connector representation needed for PCB connectivity; do not reopen unrelated schematic topology.

deferred_fabrication_or_release_gates: manufacturer DC-bias / temperature / ESR and magnetics curves hash-bound review
real DUT adapter thresholds, leakage and shutdown-time measurements
low-energy fixture acceptance and cable-fault injection
Vivado I/O DRC raw evidence and functional STA/CDC closure
EMC, power-down, fault injection and FOC closed-loop acceptance
note: Exact carrier mechanical coordinates are a PCB-geometry input, not a reason to return to broad schematic redesign. Fabrication/release evidence remains fail-closed and does not block the independent Layout work listed above.
